- The initial monolithic rigidity check timed out under shared resource contention, so it was split into the two verified modules above. One early uniformization check also failed transiently for the same resource/import contention; the subsequent definitive check passed.
- Live hgraph is synchronized at 468 nodes, 164 edges, `stale=0` (252 Lean, 216 TeX). The frozen blueprint has no approved `\lean` links, so its TeX nodes remain empty/unattached; durable linkage still needs human approval. Final tracked dashboard publication timed out, leaving the cached `Mumford.json` at 238 versus 252 live Lean declarations.
- The substantive remaining blocker is existence of the analytic Lie uniformization theorem. Two earlier commits (`f57e2988da`, `81a977e734`) lack `Summary` trailers; this is metadata-only and was not rewritten.

## Why I stopped

The objective is partly advanced, not complete. Several independent verified units were committed, but analytic existence and approved frozen-blueprint linkage remain outside what can be closed safely in this session. The standing task remains `running` as requested.

## Next

Obtain an approved durable blueprint-linkage strategy, then formalize or strengthen the analytic Lie-uniformization interface and republish the graph dashboard.
